operational.provenance: All size, mass, abilities, natural AC, HP/Hit Dice, senses, behavior, supply quantities, draw capability and reference level below are NEW provisional game values, not inferred anatomy/Strength or external bestiary statistics. Source purchase price, walking Speed and carry pounds alone are retained numbers.

hitDice.restUse: real remaining dice and ordinary creature rest/healing limits; fixed maximumHP is this NEW profile, not regenerated from a class table

operational.saves: ability modifier only unless an actual later source grants proficiency; current Wounds/conditions apply
operational.initiative: DEX modifier plus actual lawful modifiers
operational.senses: ordinary sight, hearing and smell subject to actual light, line, distance/noise; no darkvision, blindsight, special detection or automatic advantage
operational.cargoLoadProvenance: NEW explicit profile Load cap independent of Strength; not claimed source value
operational.burdenedAtLoadOrPounds: positive supported load at least half the respective limit; one Burdened speed penalty, not two for the same state
operational.hardCarryAdmission: must meet both pounds/Load and physical fit; no routine movement above either full cap
operational.riderSizeRule: at least one size smaller; saddle and actual body compatible; both personal gear and rider equipment count
operational.drawLimitProvenance: NEW separate trained-harness capability on firm rolling surface or appropriate ice/snow runners; never a five-times Strength inference
operational.drawMovement: minimum actual puller speed and vehicle cap; a gross draw above half the combined draw rating also causes the one Burdened speed penalty. Loads on a puller and towing constraints are separately checked; the same named penalty is not doubled. No slopes, broken axles or impassable terrain waived.

attack.name: Kick
attack.activation: Action on its own independent regular turn only; one attack
attack.critical: Core natural20 doubles damage dice only; natural1 misses

operational.otherActions: independent actual creature may use physically compatible Core Actions; controlled ridden Action list is Dash, Disengage, Dodge only; no Multiattack or automatic opportunity attack while controlled
operational.deathRule: NEW default registered Expedition mount is significant and uses ordinary Core Wounds/dying/death saves. dailyFeed.meaning: NEW one animal-day sold feed quantity for this template at the printed5cp daily reference. Actual species-compatible stock must be supplied; no fodder-to-meat conversion or infinite vendor stock.

Independent is a behavioral/turn designation, not permission for a player to direct a third free combat character. A mount's sale, ownership, restraint or payment does not demonstrate willingness or training. An actual independent NPC who joins as a character counts in the12-character roster. A merely ridden animal is not another member seat, but its actor/action/food/cargo records remain real.

NEW riding command bridge: a conscious nonincapacitated seated rider with a usable trained audible or tactile/rein channel can direct the controlled mount's intended movement and choose its one allowed Action (Dash, Disengage or Dodge) for the linked regular-turn sequence. The actual short cue fits LAX's shared speech allowance, or the practiced reins/weight cue uses that existing trained channel; it is not a free universal language. Reins need one actually available hand; trained tactile seat/leg cues may be used only where that individual was trained for them and the current seat/movement permits. No separate Bonus Action is imposed for this ordinary riding direction. It does not issue a class companion/device command, spend/refund its allowance, enable a controlled attack or transfer the rider's class bonuses to the animal. Physical driving a carriage/ship has its own paid Actions under TR-08/09.

A controlled mount has its own regular creature turn under TR-03 and counts as one commanded independent-turn actor toward the Loop's existing limit of two controlled independent combat-capable subordinates per controller; the controller's own character is not one of those subordinates. Source-bound companions using an attached phase and no full turn retain their own shared BA/one-offensive-allowance rules and do not acquire a full turn from the mount label. Do not compress excess ordinary independent animals into a newly invented swarm: a genuine cohort stat block would be needed. Additional ordinary pack animals may be led noncombat at actual handling cost but gain no third controlled combat turn/attack; if independent, the Director resolves their genuine agency rather than taking player attack orders.

When an essential control predicate is lost before the mount acts (rider no longer seated, incapacitated, no usable cue, mount incapacitated/unwilling), its still-existing turn does not disappear or refresh. Without a valid current rider cue it defensively Dodges if able and stays still or moves only to an actually available immediately safer space, chosen by its real agency, not a free tactical attack order. A cue already executed is not undone; an issued but unexecuted ordinary riding cue is rechecked at execution and cannot compel an animal whose current control relation ended. This differs explicitly from the protected already-issued attached companion command, whose owner becoming incapacitated alone need not cancel it. A standing trained noncombat lead/follow cue outside danger may continue when its actual conditions and handler remain available; no unattended mount program or unlimited work follows.

NEW training completion: for a genuinely tame/willing ordinary specimen, basic riding or harness training is one40-active-hour course for that named function; each actual animal can credit at most four training hours/day, and trainer time counts as work. Instructor requires actual Animal Handling proficiency, suitable safe space, properly fitting tack and a usable conditioning method. Credit15-minute completed phases; interruption loses only unfinished phase credit, not actual time/feed/cost. The NEW full-course instruction reference is5gp, actual tuition/voluntary arrangements may differ; feed/water/tack/stabling are real separate provisions unless included in a documented offer. Completion is deterministic after the actual course and demonstrated safe routine behavior, not a magical obedience check; it grants only that practiced ordinary function. Previously genuinely documented training needs no retroactive course.
